propositions: The shutdown drain waits only on the webhook queue via queue.join(), leaving reconciler reviews in flight unprotected and vulnerable to cancellation within shutdown_cancel_seconds (~10s).
When queue.join() returns immediately with an empty queue, the reconcile_loop task is cancelled before an in-flight review_and_vote completes, causing silent abandonment of backfill work.
Container stops outside the autodeploy path (manual docker compose restart, systemd stop, rollback) kill reconciler reviews with no drain protection.
A cooperative stop mechanism prevents new reconciler reviews from starting during shutdown, bounding the drain to the existing shutdown_drain_seconds budget shared with the webhook queue.
The reconcile loop uses voter.in_flight_reviews() as a gate for the drain, avoiding redundant waits on already-protected worker reviews queued through the webhook path.
The stop flag must clear after shutdown completes, not at startup, to prevent silent review skipping in subsequent reconcile_once calls within the same process.
